caption: The drawing consists of two separate sections, each framed by faint rectangular lines. In the upper section, there is a flowering plant with three green ovate leaves and three coral-colored flowers, one of which is larger and more intricate, with red and orange petals radiating around a yellow center. The leaves are mostly blue-green and attached to a pale grayish stem. In the lower section, there is a curved green stem with three blue-green leaves. Perched on the stem are two birds, both with orange bodies, red wings, yellow heads, orange beaks, and black legs. Next to the lower bird, a large butterfly with blue wings and circular markings in yellow and blue is positioned, with its wings spread open. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Applique Quilt
